book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.ar: طار لفوق، لفوق، لحد ما صارت الجزيرة نقطة.
sentences.en: It flew up, and up, until the island was a dot.

sentences.ar: وأنا معلق بإجره، والريح بتضربني، والغيم حوالي.
sentences.en: And I hung from its leg, the wind striking me, the clouds around me.
I closed my eyes, and said the prayer of the dying.
And after hours, I felt it descending.
It came down on rocky ground, and stood.

sentences.ar: فكيت العمامة بسرعة، وركضت بعيد عنه.
sentences.en: I untied the turban quickly, and ran far from it.
And it did not see me.
It seized a huge snake in its claws, and flew.
And I sat looking around me.

sentences.ar: كنت بوادي عميق، وحواليه جبال عالية من كل جهة.
sentences.en: I was in a deep valley, with high mountains around it on every side.

sentences.ar: ما في طريق يطلع، ولا شجر، ولا مي.
sentences.en: No path going up, no trees, no water.
And the ground was all shining stones.
I picked one up, and saw it: a diamond.
The whole valley was diamonds.
More than all the treasuries of the caliphs.

sentences.ar: وقلت: يا ما أغنى إنسان بالدنيا، وأنا رح أموت هون.
sentences.en: And I said: what a rich man I am, and I am going to die here.
And then I saw what lived in the valley.
Snakes.

sentences.ar: حيات كبيرة، طولها زي النخلة، بتنام بالنهار وبتطلع بالليل.
sentences.en: Huge snakes, long as palm trees, sleeping by day and coming out at night.
And these were what the Rukh hunted.

sentences.ar: لما إجا الليل، فتشت على مغارة، ولقيت وحدة زغيرة.
sentences.en: When night came, I looked for a cave, and found a small one.
I went in, and blocked its mouth with a stone.

sentences.ar: وطول الليل، سمعت الحيات بتزحف برا، وبتفح.
sentences.en: And all night, I heard the snakes crawling outside, and hissing.
And I did not sleep.

sentences.ar: بالصبح، طلعت، وأنا نص ميت من التعب والخوف.
sentences.en: In the morning, I came out, half dead from exhaustion and fear.

sentences.ar: ومشيت بالوادي، وفجأة وقع جنبي إشي من فوق.
sentences.en: And I walked through the valley, and suddenly something fell beside me from above.
A piece of meat.
Big, fresh, and slaughtered.
I looked up, and saw no one.
The mountain was very high.
And then a second piece fell, and a third.
And I remembered another story from the sailors.
A story about the diamond merchants.

sentences.ar: وكيف بيطلعوا الألماس من وادي ما حدا بيقدر ينزله.
sentences.en: And how they get diamonds out of a valley no one can descend into.
